description: This file defines the SwiftUI view 'ContextMenuCardView' responsible for rendering a context usage card in the menu bar, showing session details, usage bars, and handling loading and empty states.

classes.name: ContextMenuCardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that displays a context usage card in the menu bar, including session information, usage bars, and placeholder views during loading.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for ContextMenuCardView, sets up session rows, optional status text, and loading state.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view hierarchy for the ContextMenuCardView, displaying different UI elements based on session state.

methods.name: subtitle
methods.description: Computes the subtitle string showing the number of sessions.

methods.name: sessionRow
methods.description: Creates a view for individual session row with usage bar and labels.

methods.name: placeholderRow
methods.description: Creates a placeholder row view for loading state.
